message: Running command: cd /workspace/_work/src && git log --oneline --all -- testing/fuzzing/snmp_config_fuzzer.c | head

message.content:
`register_mib_handlers` does NOT register the enum handler. So the `snmp_config_fuzzer` as-is wouldn't trigger `se_read_conf`. 

This means the benchmark harness must be different. Let me reconsider. Perhaps the benchmark uses a different fuzzer or a custom harness that calls `init_snmp_enum`. 

Actually, let me reconsider. The OSS-Fuzz issue 396958482 was triggered by some fuzzer. Let me check the OSS-Fuzz net-snmp project to see which fuzzer. Actually, the crash stack `se_read_conf run_config_handler snmp_config_when` strongly suggests the config fuzzer. But the enum handler needs registration.

Wait — maybe the OSS-Fuzz build for net-snmp uses a different fuzzer source, or the fuzzer was modified. Let me check the git history of the fuzzer file.
